entries.title: Infinitary on your iPhone and iPad keeps a long answer coming on a slow connection
entries.body: On a very slow connection, such as weak mobile data, Infinitary on your iPhone or iPad no longer gives up on a long answer from your computer, such as a long list of cards, when it takes more than about 40 seconds to arrive, which left it out of reach and starting over. Your computer now sends a long answer in parts, so your phone hears each part arrive and stays connected until it has the whole answer. A computer that stops answering is still noticed.
entries.noPicture: The change is in a connection staying up while a long answer arrives, which a still picture cannot show.
